title: DNA Concentration Normalization
author: Opentrons
materials: Create your CSV file according to our instructions.

steps.title: Gather required hardware and labware
steps.instruction: Ensure you have an Opentrons OT-2 robot, the OT-2 Run App version 3.20.0 or later, Opentrons P10 and P50 single-channel pipettes (GEN1) with compatible tips, a 4-in-1 tube rack set with a 4 × 6 insert for 2 mL Eppendorf tubes, and standard PCR strips.

steps.title: Create CSV file with layout
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file with the exact headers: Source tube rack,Source tube well,Destination well,Vol. of DNA (?gL),Vol. of diluent (?gL). Populate each row with the source rack slot, source well, destination well, DNA volume (µg/L) and diluent volume (µg/L) as in the example: Slot 3,A1,A1,7,8; Slot 3,B1,B1,6.4,8.6; Slot 3,C1,C1,9.2,5.8; Slot 3,D1,D1,6,9.

steps.title: Upload CSV and configure settings
steps.instruction: In the OT-2 Run App, upload the prepared CSV file and select all desired settings as described in the Setup section to customize the protocol run.

steps.title: Download generated OT-2 protocol
steps.instruction: Click the blue “Download” button above the deck map to download the customized OT-2 protocol file.

steps.title: Upload protocol to Opentrons App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons App, then follow the on-screen instructions to set up the deck layout, calibrate the labware, and start the run.

steps.title: Add samples and load plate
steps.instruction: Place your source plate containing the DNA samples into the designated labware on the deck before starting; ensure the source plate holds the samples you intend to pick.
